operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are backtick-quoted in DDL; generated SQL must double-quote them ("Products", "product_id").
Mixed-case table names (Products, Regular_Orders, Delivery_Route_Locations, Order_Deliveries) and mixed-case columns; column lookup must be case-insensitive.
DATETIME columns store TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (space separator, no T, no fractional seconds); storage class text contradicts declared DATETIME.
DATETIME dispatch: type contains 'date' -> Number(scale=4) if first element parses as int else Date; here elements are '2011-04-25 22:20:35' (not int) so Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.
DECIMAL(19,4) -> Number(scale=4, precision=19); product_price stored as real, samples like 1322.78.
VARCHAR(n) -> String(length=n) for all text columns; product_description VARCHAR(255) but only 3 distinct values.
location_code is VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY and also an FK target from Order_Deliveries; values are street-like strings ('04 Elm Rd') not codes.
No composite PKs; Regular_Order_Products, Actual_Order_Products, Customer_Addresses, Order_Deliveries have NO primary key (pk=[]).
All FKs resolve to existing parents (parent_exists true); no dangling FKs, no self-references.

FK columns are NOT NULL (distributer_id, regular_order_id, product_id, address_id, customer_id, employee_address_id, location_code, actual_order_id, driver_employee_id, truck_id) — empty parent would force NULL and fail insert.
Tiny tables: Products 6 rows, all others 15 rows; no huge-table sampling needed.
country has distinct=1 ('USA'); zip_postcode distinct=14 of 15 (one duplicate); most other columns fully distinct.
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on DATETIME columns: template %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S, range from min/max parsed originals (e.g. 2009-12-29..2018-03-21), fresh draws uniform in that range.
String fuzzer on VARCHAR columns: random strings over a-zA-Z 0-9() of length up to declared length, plus 0.5 contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop) — names, cities, emails, phones become implausible.
Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] with +-1/+-2 perturbation; PKs become large/negative ints, not 1..15.
Number fuzzer on DECIMAL(19,4): scale=4 -> range [-10^4,10^4], float perturbation +-0.01/+-0.02; product_price plausible magnitude but random.
FK columns draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement -> many-to-one ties preserved; but parent PKs are random ints so joins still work.
Tables with no PK (Regular_Order_Products etc.) get no PK dedup; unique-column dedup only applies to single-column unique indexes (none here).
NOT NULL columns (payment_method, order_status_code, address_type, delivery_status_code, all FK cols) may get NULL from String/Number samplers -> insert fails, row skipped, table shrinks.

String fuzzer on payment_method/order_status_code/address_type/delivery_status_code: original 2-4 enum values replaced by random strings -> queries filtering 'Visa'/'Success'/'House'/'Ready' return empty (FN).
String fuzzer on location_code (PK, VARCHAR(10)): random strings, not street names; FK from Order_Deliveries still consistent but values implausible.
Date fuzzer on date_from/date_to: independent draws -> date_to < date_from possible (no ordering constraint enforced).
country distinct=1 'USA': String fuzzer replaces with random strings -> WHERE country='USA' returns empty (FN).
zip_postcode has one duplicate in original; TS String fuzzer produces mostly distinct values -> GROUP BY zip_postcode cardinality changes (FP/FN).
